description_en: Calls AddRecordTemplate to add a recording configuration template
description_zh: 调用AddRecordTemplate添加录制配置模板
kebab_example: aliyun rtc add-record-template --layout-ids 2 --formats mp4 --app-id yourAppId --name '录制模板' --task-profile 4IN_1080P --media-encode 20 --oss-bucket rtc-record-oss --oss-file-prefix record/_AppId_/_ChannelId_TaskId_/_EscapedStartTime_EscapedEndTime --file-split-interval 1800 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddRecordTemplate

parameters.help_en: Application ID. Created and queried via the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
Task billing configuration. Charges vary based on your settings. See the TaskProfile enumeration values below.

The resolution of the encoding option MediaEncode must be less than or equal to the resolution of TaskProfile.
The maximum number of panes in a layout must be less than or equal to the number of input streams of TaskProfile
parameters.help_zh:
任务计费配置，根据您的不同设置，进行收费。请参见下文中的TaskProfile枚举值。

编码选项MediaEncode的分辨率需要小于等于TaskProfile的分辨率。
布局最大窗格数需要小于等于TaskProfile的输入路数
parameters.name: task_profile

parameters.help_en: Encoding option. See the MediaEncode enumeration values below
parameters.help_zh: 编码选项，请参见下文中的MediaEncode枚举值
parameters.name: media_encode

parameters.help_en: Background color RGB. The default is 0 (black). The calculation formula is R + G × 256 + B × 65536. R (red), G (green), and B (blue) each range from 0 to 255
parameters.help_zh: 背景色RGB。默认是0（黑色）。计算公式为R+G×256+B×65536，R（红）、G（绿）、B（蓝）的取值：0~255
parameters.name: background_color

parameters.help_en:
OSS bucket where the recording files are stored.

Currently, only OSS buckets in the Shanghai region are supported
parameters.help_zh:
录制文件存储的OSS bucket。

目前仅支持上海区域OSS bucket
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en:
Naming rule for recording files.

To ensure that recording file names are unique, the current naming rule is record/{AppId}/{ChannelId_TaskId}/{EscapedStartTime}_{EscapedEndTime}
parameters.help_zh:
录制文件命名规则。

为确保录制的文件名称唯一，目前录制文件的命名规则为record/{AppId}/{ChannelId_TaskId}/{EscapedStartTime}_{EscapedEndTime}
parameters.name: oss_file_prefix

parameters.help_en: Recording file split duration (greater than or equal to 1800). Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 录制文件切割时长（大于等于1800）。单位：秒
parameters.name: file_split_interval

parameters.help_en: Delay time before stopping recording. Unit: seconds. Default value: 180 seconds
parameters.help_zh: 延时停止录制的时间。单位：秒。默认值为180秒
parameters.name: delay_stop_time

parameters.help_en:
Message queue for recording event callbacks.

One and only one of this parameter and HttpCallbackUrl must be provided; you cannot provide both or neither
parameters.help_zh:
录制事件回调消息队列。

此参数和HttpCallbackUrl必须输入其中某一个，不能两者都输入或都不输入
parameters.name: mns_queue

parameters.help_en:
HTTP callback URL for recording events.
One and only one of this parameter and MnsQueue must be provided; you cannot provide both or neither
parameters.help_zh:
录制事件HTTP回调地址。
此参数和MnsQueue必须输入其中某一个，不能两者都输入或都不输入
parameters.name: http_callback_url

parameters.help_en: Whether the recorded m3u8 file needs to include the timestamp of the ts file
parameters.help_zh: 录制的m3u8文件是否需要加上ts文件时间点
parameters.name: enable_m3u8_date_time
